title: Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Brookhouse Aerospace produces a range of composite structures, producing monolithic and sandwich parts from a range of materials, including carbon fibre composite, glass and Aramid cured by autoclave. Brookhouse Aerospace also manufactures sheet metal fabrications and machined metal parts, fully supply kits and integrated assemblies. Specialist capabilities include a full range of surface treatments and dedicated Spares and Repairs capability.

Who we are

Find out more about Brookhouse Aerospace.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Data Analyst with strong coding capabilities to support the development of business intelligence, reporting, and data-driven decision making.

The successful candidate will be responsible for transforming raw data into meaningful insights, building dashboards, and improving data processes across the organisation.

This is a fixed term contract initially, with the possibility of a permanent role depending on business needs.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports

Collect, clean, and analyse data from multiple systems (HR, finance, operations, Epicor MRP)

Write and maintain code for data extraction, transformation, and automation

Identify trends, patterns, and insights to support business decisions

Work with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and KPIs

Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency

Automate manual reporting processes to improve efficiency

Support the implementation of new data systems or tools

Provide training and guidance to users on dashboards and reporting tools

The Candidate:

Strong coding skills

Experience with data visualisation tools

Strong data manipulation and analysis skills

Ability to work with large datasets and multiple data sources

Advanced Excel skills

Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data to non-technical stakeholders

Experience building data pipelines or ETL processes

Knowledge of databases and data warehousing concepts

Understanding of data governance and GDPR principles

Highly organised and detail-focused

Proactive and able to work independently

Strong stakeholder engagement skills

Curious mindset with a passion for data

What We Offer:

4 day working week

Holidays start at 28 days per year (including Bank Holidays) (Based on a 4-day week).

On-site - Occupational Health

Employee Referral Scheme

Corporate Health Cash Plan (Benefit in Kind)

Life Insurance x 2 annual salary

We've signed the Gradcracker feedback pledge.

(This means that we will supply feedback if requested after an interview.)
